Every payload timestamp below was checked against wall clock before use: ticker 0.46s, open interest 0.7s, funding 28.6s, the 1H long/short account ratio at the 12:00Z bucket, and the 100 most recent filled BTC-USDT swap liquidations with the newest 5.3 minutes old. changePct is against the rolling 24h open of 79,600.0. THIS REPORT WAS WRITTEN INSIDE A LIVE CASCADE AND THE READER SHOULD TREAT THE PRICE AS A MOVING TARGET. The first pull of this session, at 12:51:44Z, read 77,041.9. Four minutes later it read 76,969.3. At 12:55:48Z it reads 76,736.5 - 305.4 points lower in 4 minutes 4 seconds while the report was being assembled. The 12:30Z 15m candle opened 77,814.3 and closed 77,138.0, a 676.3-point range in fifteen minutes; the 12:45Z candle traded down to 76,680.0. Against endday's 78,283.0 read this is minus 1,546.5 points, minus 1.98 percent, across 13 hours 17 minutes, and minus 3.60 percent on the 24h open. SCHEDULING COLLISION - RECORDED BECAUSE IT CHANGES HOW THIS REPORT SHOULD BE READ. The midnight session did NOT run at its 02:00 COT slot. It fired LATE and stamped 2026-09-10T07:54:02-05:00, one minute and fifty-eight seconds before this report, marking 76,872.4. This session began its data pull with no 2026-09-10 midnight file on disk and correctly opened against yesterday's endday; midnight's file appeared mid-run. Both baselines are therefore quoted below and neither is hidden. Against MIDNIGHT, price is minus 135.9 points and minus 0.18 percent in under two minutes - a delta so short that no 1H candle settled between the two reports, which is why midnight's 76,629.9 reduce and 77,051.4 add gates are left unresolved in calibration rather than scored. Against ENDDAY, the meaningful comparison, price is minus 1,546.5 points and minus 1.98 percent across 13 hours 17 minutes. The two reports were written into the same cascade from the same feed and reached the same structural floor independently - midnight put its invalidation at 76,261.0 and so does this one - but they diverge on what to DO, and that divergence is deliberate: midnight bought, this session sells into it. The disagreement is argued in the decision box rather than smoothed over.

READ THE LESSON LOG BEFORE ACTING ON IT: a gate that clears by less than one ATR needs a SECOND settled close behind it. That rule was bought with midnight's 51.5-point failure on 09 September and confirmed by morning's 92.4-point refusal the same day. Do not pay for one candle here.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from endday's ADD to REDUCE, and the reversal is not a change of mind - it is the written plan executing exactly as it was written. Endday set the invalidation at 77,624.6 and RECOMMENDED a resting stop at 77,620.0 for the first time in five sessions, arguing that three consecutive wick-pierces had made the level a trap and that the stop therefore belonged BELOW the trap. The low is 76,680.0. The stop filled, 944.6 points above where price now trades, and for the first time in five sessions declining it would have been WRONG by 883.5 points. Endday's reduce gate at 77,924.4 also fired cleanly on the settled 10:00Z close of 77,861.9, clearing by 62.5 points and confirmed by 11:00Z at 77,840.0 before the break. Both written levels worked. THREE THINGS ARE GENUINELY NEW SINCE 19:38 COT AND ALL THREE POINT THE SAME WAY. FIRST, an oil supply shock. Brent trades 105.62, up 4.36 percent on the session from a 101.21 close, after the Iran-Hormuz escalation broadened - US Central Command strikes on Iranian tankers and Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities. SECOND, rates took it straight to the front end of the curve: the US 10-year prints 4.91 percent against yesterday's 4.84 percent close, another 52-week high, and the 30-year 5.342 percent. The dollar index is up to 99.099. That is an inflationary supply shock repricing the discount rate, which is the single most hostile macro combination for a long-duration risk asset. THIRD, and this is the part that separates today from the last six sessions, POSITIONING DID NOT DELEVERAGE - IT REBUILT. Open interest is 2,169,286,257 USD, UP 4.15 percent from endday's 2,082,796,486, funding is +0.0001000000000000, UP 117.2 percent from endday's +0.0000460535265445, and the 1H long/short account ratio prints 1.42, the HIGHEST reading this dashboard has recorded, set while price was making the low. Endday measured a genuine 4.06 percent deleveraging across yesterday and read it constructively. Overnight the crowd put every bit of it back on, at higher prices, and is now being removed for it: 5,771,456 USD of long liquidations in a NINE-SECOND window at 12:47:14Z with ZERO short liquidations against them, 100 of 100 fills sell-side. The reduce is 25 percent of the spot book and nothing more, because the wallet is 97 percent long into this and the honest correction is to raise cash, not to capitulate at the low of a cascade. THE DISAGREEMENT WITH MIDNIGHT, STATED PLAINLY. Midnight fired late at 07:54 COT, read the same cascade from the same endpoints, and took the opposite side: position ADD, a 4.00 USDT spot tranche at 76,872.4 bought as the seeder with the last of the free cash, leaving 2.25 USDT of cash against roughly 193 USDT of spot - a book that is 98.8 percent long into an active one-sided liquidation event. That tranche is already 135.9 points offside at this mark. Its argument was that the 5.77 million USD of forced selling had cleared the levered longs out and that a reclaim of the 77,051.4 daily EMA20 would confirm the flush was absorbed. That argument is coherent and it may yet be right. This session rejects it on one specific measurement: open interest is UP 4.15 percent and the long/short account ratio is at an all-time series high of 1.42 AFTER the cascade, which means the levered longs were NOT cleared out - they were replaced within the hour, at lower prices, and are still paying to be there. A flush that removes leverage is a floor; a flush that is immediately re-levered is a staging area. The 25 percent spot reduce is sized as a disagreement, not a repudiation: it leaves three quarters of the core intact so that midnight's thesis still gets paid if it is right, while raising the cash the book needs to act at 76,261.0 if it is not. Note what BOTH sessions agree on, because it is the more actionable half - the invalidation is 76,261.0 and a resting stop is recommended there.

Overnight the crowd put it all back on and then some: open interest is 2,169,286,257 USD (28,280.529 BTC), UP 4.15 percent from endday's 2,082,796,486 and now ABOVE where morning of 09 September started. Funding is +0.0001000000000000 for the period settling 2026-09-10T16:00Z, UP 117.2 percent from endday's +0.0000460535265445 - longs are paying more than double what they paid last night. And the 1H long/short account ratio has climbed 1.32 to 1.37 to 1.40 to 1.41 to 1.42 across the 05:00Z through 12:00Z buckets, the HIGHEST reading this dashboard has ever recorded, set while price was making a 24-hour low. Notional came back, conviction never left, and the 4.15 percent OI increase measured AFTER a 5.77-million-dollar liquidation event means the book is being rebuilt as fast as it is being destroyed. That is not a floor; that is fuel. TWO NON-OSCILLATOR DIVERGENCES BELONG ON THE RECORD HERE, because the report's divergences array is empty and that emptiness is a real finding rather than a gap: no frame shows a genuine RSI or MACD divergence this session - 15m RSI printed its lowest reading of the series ON the lowest price, which is confirmation, not divergence. What DOES diverge is not an oscillator. FIRST, SENTIMENT AGAINST PRICE: the Alternative.me Fear and Greed Index printed 66 on 09 September and reads 69 today - sentiment IMPROVED three points while price fell 1,546.5 points and 1.98 percent to a 24-hour low. A greed reading of 69 into a one-sided long liquidation event says retail positioning has not yet registered what happened. SECOND, OPEN INTEREST AGAINST PRICE: price down 1.98 percent from 78,283.0 to 76,736.5 while open interest rose 4.15 percent from 2,082,796,486 to 2,169,286,257 USD over the same window. Rising open interest on falling price is either new short interest or longs averaging down, and the 1.42 account ratio with +0.0001 funding settles that question decisively in favour of the second. Both readings say the same thing from different angles: the crowd is long, it is adding, and it does not yet think anything is wrong.

calibration.rollingRecord: Endday 09 September went 3-for-3 on its written levels: the 77,924.4 reduce gate fired on the settled 10:00Z close of 77,861.9 and price is 1,125.4 points lower; the 78,611.2 add gate refused, with a session high of 78,552.6 missing it by 58.6 points; and the 77,620.0 resting stop - recommended for the first time in five sessions - filled 944.6 points above spot. Today's midnight row is deliberately scored null on both gates: it ran 1 minute 58 seconds before this report and no 1H candle settled in between, so there was nothing to resolve.
calibration.note: The stop is the entry worth recording. Four consecutive sessions had DECLINED a resting stop and been right every time, and endday broke the streak on an explicit argument: three wick-pierces had turned the stated invalidation into a trap, so place the stop BELOW the trap at 77,620.0 rather than skip it. The low is 76,680.0. The stop filled and saved 883.5 points against spot. The transferable rule is that the wick-pierce pattern is evidence about WHERE to put a stop, not evidence against having one - and it took five sessions and one genuine break to separate those two claims. A second entry belongs in the log today and it is procedural rather than technical. A session that fires hours late inherits the NEXT session's information set while still being scored against its own slot. Midnight is nominally the 02:00 COT read - it would have seen price near 78,300 and an intact range - but it actually executed at 07:54 into the wreckage, and it seeded the wallet's last free cash on that basis. The desk should treat a late-firing seeder's position as unconfirmed rather than established, which is exactly how this session has sized around it. A third, purely mechanical entry: this run validated its own output against the app's compiled zod ReportSchema rather than against the skill's documentation, and the two disagreed. The documented divergence shape takes a free-form type, a free-form oscillator and numeric priceFrom/priceTo; the app requires type in regular_bullish|regular_bearish|hidden_bullish|hidden_bearish, oscillator in rsi|macd, and priceFrom/priceTo as {t, price} objects. Two entries written to the documented shape parsed to an empty array via the schema's .catch([]) - they would have vanished silently, with the report still rendering green. Validating against the real schema, not the doc, is now part of the checklist.
